enabled.description: Omitted/true = shown on the live site; false = staged but hidden (filtered out in app.js before sort/stamp-assignment/navigation).

location.description: Postmark location text. May be empty on an unfinished draft.

color.description: A name key from palette.json's colors. Omitted = a color is picked deterministically from the postcard's date.

font.description: An id from fonts.json. Not currently used by any entry; the renderer defaults if omitted.

subject.description: Typed header shown above the message. May be empty.

media.description: Omitted on an unfinished draft, which renders the mediaFallbackText placeholder instead.

message.description: The handwritten letter body. \n separates paragraphs. May be empty on an unfinished draft.

postscript.description: Rendered as a 'P.S. <postscript>' line after the message/signature. Omitted/empty = not shown.
